cells.gaps: In July 2026 ANATS's director general said the births a national campaign collects will be entered in the biometric register (TCD-004); that is an intention, and no source says births or deaths are entered now. The finance ministry's March 2026 protocol to consult the register (TCD-002) answers question 4 but cannot count while question 3 is unmet.
cells.note: Stage 3 on ANATS's statement of March 2026 that an integrated population system based on the biometric register is deployed. Stage 4 needs births or deaths entered in it, and the July 2026 statement says only that campaign births will be.
